subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should Slack channel creation and Discord CLI channel administration be callable only through explicit provider opt-in gates plus a distinct administrative requester authorization check?
rationale: The architecture supports the capability, but workspace/server mutation authority, credential selection, and which message-action callers may invoke it are security and product-policy choices that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Gate and authorize administration
options.body: Keep provider action gates default-off and require a distinct maintainer-approved administrative authorization check before workspace or server mutation.

options.title: Use provider gate alone
options.body: Treat the provider configuration gate and existing message-action write authority as sufficient, documenting the intentional expansion of authority.

options.title: Keep provisioning external
options.body: Do not expose channel creation through OpenClaw and continue directing operators to provider APIs or external automation.

recommendation.title: Gate and authorize administration
recommendation.body: Keep provider action gates default-off and require a distinct maintainer-approved administrative authorization check before workspace or server mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest consolidation of the relevant surfaces and already reviewed this exact authority boundary in the issue discussion.
